grid.title: DASH - ACOMPANHAMENTO CONTRATOS DE LICITACAO
grid.expression: SELECT LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO CONTRATO, TCSCON.LGH_PROCESSO AS NR_PROCESSO, TCSCON.AD_PREGAO AS PREGAO, LGH_LICMOD.DESCRICAO AS MODALIDADE, LGH_LICCONT.NUMEROCONTRATOCLIENTE AS CONT_CLIENTE, TCSCON.CODPARC AS PARCEIRO, TGFPAR.RAZAOSOCIAL, TGFPAR.NOMEPARC AS NOME_FANTASIA, TGFPRO.REFFORN AS CATALAGO, LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AS COD_PRODUTO, TGFPRO.DESCRPROD AS DESCRICAO, LGH_LICCONT.DTCONTRATO DT_CONTRATO, LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO AS DT_TERMINO, TGFPRO.MARCA MARCA, ROUND(AVG(LGH_LICITECON.VLRUNIT),2) AS VLR_UNIT, SUM(LGH_LICITECON.QTDEPREVISTA) AS QTD_PREVISTA, SUM(LGH_LICITECON.VLRUNIT*LGH_LICITECON.QTDEPREVISTA) AS VLR_PREVISTO, -- Busca pedidos programados específicos do contrato (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA IS NULL AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('910','911','1183') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AND TGFITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND TGFITE.QTDNEG > TGFITE.QTDENTREGUE) AS QTD_PROGRAMADA, -- Busca notas faturadas específicas do contrato (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA = 2 AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('1000','1100','1107') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD) AS QTD_FATURADA, -- Valor faturado do contrato (AVG(LGH_LICITECON.VLRUNIT) * (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA = 2 AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('1000','1100','1107') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD)) AS VLR_FATURADO, -- Saldo do produto do contrato (Previsto - Faturado) (SUM(LGH_LICITECON.QTDEPREVISTA) - (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA = 2 AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('1000','1100','1107') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD)) AS SLD_PRODUTO, -- Saldo disponível livre real (Previsto - Programado - Faturado) (SUM(LGH_LICITECON.QTDEPREVISTA) - (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'P' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA IS NULL AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('910','911','1183') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AND TGFITE.PENDENTE = 'S' AND TGFITE.QTDNEG > TGFITE.QTDENTREGUE) - (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA = 2 AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('1000','1100','1107') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD)) AS SLD_DISPONIVEL, ROUND((((AVG(LGH_LICITECON.VLRUNIT) * (SELECT ISNULL(SUM(TGFITE.QTDNEG),0) FROM TGFCAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ON TGFITE.NUNOTA = TGFCAB.NUNOTA WHERE TGFCAB.TIPMOV = 'V' AND TGFCAB.SERIENOTA = 2 AND TGFCAB.CODTIPOPER IN ('1000','1100','1107') AND TGFCAB.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO AND TGFITE.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD)) / NULLIF(SUM(LGH_LICITECON.VLRUNIT*LGH_LICITECON.QTDEPREVISTA), 0) )*100 ),0) AS PER_ATENDIDO, (SELECT SUM(TGFEST.ESTOQUE) FROM TGFEST WHERE TGFEST.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AND TGFEST.CODPARC = 0 AND TGFEST.ESTOQUE > 0 AND TGFEST.DTVAL >= DateAdd("D",0,GETDATE()) ) AS ESTOQUE, (SELECT SUM(TGFEST.RESERVADO) FROM TGFEST WHERE TGFEST.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AND TGFEST.CODPARC = 0 AND TGFEST.RESERVADO > 0 AND TGFEST.DTVAL >= DateAdd("D",0, GETDATE()) ) AS RESERVADO, ((SELECT SUM(TGFEST.ESTOQUE) FROM TGFEST WHERE TGFEST.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AND TGFEST.CODPARC = 0 AND TGFEST.ESTOQUE > 0 AND TGFEST.DTVAL >= DateAdd("D",0,GETDATE()) ) - (SELECT SUM(TGFEST.RESERVADO) FROM TGFEST WHERE TGFEST.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD AND TGFEST.CODPARC = 0 AND TGFEST.RESERVADO > 0 AND TGFEST.DTVAL >= DateAdd("D",0,GETDATE()) )) AS DISPONIVEL, DATEDIFF(day,GETDATE(),LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO) DIAS_AVENCER, TGFTPP.DESCRTIPPARC PERFIL_PARCEIRO, TGFVEN.APELIDO VENDEDOR, CASE WHEN ( DATEDIFF(day,GETDATE(),LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO) <= 90) THEN '#FF0000' WHEN ( DATEDIFF(day,GETDATE(),LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO) > 90 AND DATEDIFF(day,GETDATE(),LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO) <= 180) THEN '#FFFF00' WHEN ( DATEDIFF(day,GETDATE(), LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO) > 180) THEN '#00FF00' ELSE '' END AS BKCOLOR, CASE WHEN ( DATEDIFF(day,GETDATE(),LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO) < 90) THEN '#FFFFFF' ELSE '' END AS FGCOLOR FROM LGH_LICITECON INNER JOIN LGH_LICCONT ON LGH_LICCONT.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO INNER JOIN TCSCON ON TCSCON.NUMCONTRATO = LGH_LICCONT.NUMCONTRATO INNER JOIN TGFPAR ON TGFPAR.CODPARC = TCSCON.CODPARC INNER JOIN TGFPRO ON TGFPRO.CODPROD = LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD LEFT JOIN TGFTPP ON TGFTPP.CODTIPPARC = TGFPAR.CODTIPPARC LEFT JOIN TGFVEN ON TGFVEN.CODVEND = TGFPAR.CODVEND LEFT JOIN LGH_LICCAB ON LGH_LICCAB.NULIC = ISNULL(NULLIF(LGH_LICCONT.NULIC, 0), TCSCON.LGH_NULINC) LEFT JOIN LGH_LICMOD ON LGH_LICMOD.NUMODALIDADE = LGH_LICCAB.NUMODALIDADE WHERE LGH_LICCONT.DTCONTRATO BETWEEN :PERIODO.INI AND :PERIODO.FIN AND (TCSCON.CODPARC = :CODPARC OR :CODPARC IS NULL) AND (TCSCON.AD_PREGAO = (SELECT TOP 1 EX.AD_PREGAO FROM TCSCON EX WHERE EX.NUMCONTRATO = :NUMCONTRATO) OR :NUMCONTRATO IS NULL) AND (LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD = :CODPROD OR :CODPROD IS NULL) AND ((:SITUACAO = 'V' AND LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO <= DateAdd("D",0,GETDATE())) OR (:SITUACAO = 'N' AND LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO > DateAdd("D",0,GETDATE())) OR (:SITUACAO = 'T' AND LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO IS NOT NULL)) GROUP BY LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO, TCSCON.LGH_PROCESSO, TCSCON.AD_PREGAO, LGH_LICMOD.DESCRICAO, LGH_LICCONT.NUMEROCONTRATOCLIENTE, TCSCON.CODPARC, TGFPAR.NOMEPARC, TGFPRO.REFFORN, LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD, TGFPRO.DESCRPROD, LGH_LICCONT.DTCONTRATO, LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO, TGFPRO.MARCA, TGFTPP.DESCRTIPPARC, TGFVEN.APELIDO, TGFPAR.RAZAOSOCIAL ORDER BY LGH_LICITECON.NUMCONTRATO, TCSCON.LGH_PROCESSO, TCSCON.AD_PREGAO, LGH_LICCONT.NUMEROCONTRATOCLIENTE, TCSCON.CODPARC, TGFPAR.NOMEPARC, TGFPRO.REFFORN, LGH_LICITECON.CODPROD, TGFPRO.DESCRPROD, LGH_LICCONT.DTCONTRATO, LGH_LICCONT.DTTERMINO, TGFPRO.MARCA;
